notes: §2002:13.16.13.3 GR4: with SELECT WHEN the selected entry's usage display items convert by alphabet-name-1 and other usages do not (NOTE); with no record entries the FROM operand of WRITE FILE gives the description. Alphabet A-EBC is code-name-1 EBCDIC, implementor-defined per §2002:12.2.6.3 GR7 i) as CCSID 37 (DOC-A.1-183/184): A=C1, B=C2, P=D7, X=E7, 1=F1, so ORD of the stored byte is code+1. REC-A selected: A KEY 194, binary A-NUM bytes equal the native binary bytes (A NUM RAW SAME), A TEXT 232; REC-B by OTHER: B KEY 195, B TEXT 216; record-less FW via WRITE FILE FROM W ('AB', 9 VALUE 1)... run at --std 2002 on the pinned dc1f2dcce8 build: exit 0, 6 lines equal the derived .out (MATCH). The read's note that the pinned compiler refuses SELECT WHEN (COBOL1705) and WRITE FILE (COBOL1706) is stale: it was about 24372b7b17; dc1f2dcce8 accepts both, and the reader's own probe gr4_codeset_recordless_writefile.cob now prints its expected 194/195/242 at 2002.
